notes.title: Crowdfunding Completed – Thank You!
notes.content: [h2]【Crowdfunding Completed – Thank You!】[/h2][p][/p][p]Our crowdfunding campaign for [i]Bless You Again[/i] has officially ended on June 30th![/p][p]Thanks to incredible support from our Japanese community, we successfully raised over [b]$68,000[/b].[/p][p]Please note that the campaign was limited to residents of Japan, so unfortunately international fans were not able to contribute directly.[/p][p]However, your interest and encouragement from around the world mean a great deal to us.[/p][p]We’re truly grateful to everyone supporting [i]Bless You Again[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]The development team will now be working full speed ahead to deliver the best experience possible.[/p][p]We’ll continue to share updates here and on our X (formerly Twitter) account:[/p][p][/p][p]Official X (Twitter): [url="https://x.com/projectlilyBYA"]https://x.com/projectlilyBYA[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again, and please look forward to more![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525318/bab90a3608d880a944a1968226ad4a263025e58c.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Full Voice Acting Achieved & Onward to Costume Additions!
notes.content:
[h3]We’re sorry, but this crowdfunding campaign is only available within Japan.[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Support Our Crowdfunding Campaign!][/b][/p][p]There are only 18 days left in our current crowdfunding campaign![/p][p]Thanks to your incredible support, we've surpassed 5 million yen in funding — and full voice acting has officially been confirmed![/p][p]Thank you so much![/p][p]Our next stretch goals are:[/p][list][*][p]At 7.5 million yen: [i]A new dungeon will be added[/i][/p][/*][*][p]At 10 million yen: [i]New character costumes will be added[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]We’re aiming to make the game even more fun and fulfilling to play![/p][p]In addition, we’re planning to release an exclusive demo for backers in [b]July[/b]!
It’s your chance to be among the first to try the game — so please consider supporting us while there’s still time![/p][p]▼ Crowdfunding campaign page

notes.title: Our first gameplay footage is now live!
notes.content:
On May 4th, we showcased our prototype at an indie game event in Japan and had players try out the early demo.
https://x.com/projectlilyBYA/status/1918591363253227540
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525318/bf6f493253c9e967849aa54a9fce13f27e691f97.png[/img]

[h3]In this version, they could:[/h3]
・View the character
・Use melee attacks
・Use magic attacks
・Move and jump

That’s it for now — it's still an early prototype, not yet fully functional.
Even so, we received tons of valuable feedback, and the experience was incredibly helpful!

Today, we'd also like to share [b]the current development roadmap[/b] that we presented during the event:

By June 20:
→ Complete a full prototype (with placeholder assets)

By September 30:
→ Complete a playable demo for Steam Next Fest


[h3]Here’s what we plan to include in the prototype by June 20:[/h3]
・Upgrade system 
・Aerial attacks
・Machine gun-style magic
・Grenade-style magic
・Four elemental magic types
・Shift into fire/water/wind/ground mode *
・Boss battle
・Puzzle mechanics
・Improved enemy AI

*[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525318/4d62e44c1dbf61b0927f651b6bdfa409202c5c68.png[/img]

We’ll continue development in this direction, and we also plan to post here more frequently.
Thanks for your continued support!
